patches.name: Twitch Enhancement
patches.description: Kizu Twitch enhancements for Twitch 31.3.1, including third-party emotes, animated emotes, privacy and appearance controls, deleted-message controls, Hide Stories, ad handling, automatic Channel Points claiming, and stable default-home navigation.
